Carla: Heads-up — I'm assembling the changelog draft for the docs release (targeting tomorrow AM). Pulled in the merged PRs: #4582 (SDK snippet fixes), #4591 (redirects), #4599 (changelog bullets). Need quick eyes on the Known Issues section — there's a streaming example regression and one broken internal redirect.

Jun: @Carla on it. I'll scan #4582 for the streaming snippet. If it's the Python streaming client, I can reproduce locally.

Sam: I just landed a redirect fix for /docs/sdk/py/snippets -> /docs/sdk/python/snippets (PR #4591). Confirmed the old link 404s on staging before the fix.

Ravi: The streaming regression looks like the client sends an empty chunk when fallback routing kicks in. We should add a workaround snippet for callers to guard against empty frames. Example I tested:

```python
# guard for empty streaming frames
def process_chunk(chunk):
    if not chunk.strip():
        return None  # ignore transient empty frame
    return json.loads(chunk)
```

Carla: thanks @Ravi — adding that as a short note under Known Issues + code block. Also adding a short copy blurb for the top-level release summary: "docs: small UX polish, SDK snippet fixes, redirect cleanups; known streaming edge-case on fallback routing" — open to wording edits.

Jun: tiny nit: suggest "streaming edge case" -> "streaming edge-case when fallback routing triggers" (more precise). Also suggest we call out affected SDKs (Python + Node).

Sam: added "(Python, Node)" to the Known Issues line and pushed a tiny wording PR to the draft: #4602.

Carla: great. Can someone proof the bullets for clarity? I'm trying to keep the top summary to 3 bullets: highlights, quality fixes, known issues + workaround link.

Jun: I'll proof the bullets in #4602 in 15.

docs-bot: Merged PRs since last draft: #4582, #4591, #4599. Staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-23 (expires in 48h).

Carla: perfect. If all looks good, I'll publish after the morning sanity pass. Ping me if you see anything misleading in the workaround snippet or the redirect note. :thumbsup:

Sam: LGTM from my side. :shipit:

Jun: Proofed and minor copy tweak applied. No blockers.

Ravi: OK from engineering; added a one-liner about expected timing for a full fix (ETA next minor).

Carla: thanks team — publishing tomorrow unless someone yells by 9:00am PT.
